title: Yucata Game Result Daily Event Volume
dataSources: Video-game sessions (`game:session`), achievement unlocks (`achievement:unlock`), board-game plays (`boardgame:play`), chess games (`chess:game`), dice rolls (`dice:roll`).
app: Gaming and tabletop telemetry — Steam / PSN / Xbox playtime and achievement APIs, BoardGameGeek plays export, Lichess / Chess.com game archives, and tabletop dice-roller logs — streamed to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=yucata:game
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as events, dc(game_name) as distinct_entities by _time
| sort - _time
description: Counts how many Yucata game result events land each day and how many distinct game values are represented.
value: Daily volume is the fastest way to spot a dead feed, a sudden burst, or a workflow that quietly changed.
implementation: Ingest Yucata game result records into `index=personal`; schedule daily and compare count and distinct game values against your normal baseline.
visualization: Column chart of daily event count with a line for distinct entities.
grandmaExplanation: It clearly how much Yucata game result activity showed up each day so you can see if the feed went quiet or suddenly got busy.
